frontmatter.description: User does not value restart-survival as a benefit when weighing caching strategies for RaceIQ

frontmatter.name: Prefer minimal scoped changes
frontmatter.description: User wants tight, single-purpose changes — no bundled refactors or "while we're here" fixes

frontmatter.name: database-engineer
frontmatter.description: Implements RaceIQ SQLite schema, runtime migration, query-module, and persistence changes.

frontmatter.name: frontend-engineer
frontmatter.description: Implements RaceIQ React UI, client state, typed API integration, charts, and browser-visible behavior.

frontmatter.name: mastra-engineer
frontmatter.description: Implements RaceIQ Mastra agents, AI tools, prompts, workflows, model routing, structured outputs, and evals.

frontmatter.name: raceiq-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews RaceIQ changes for correctness, regressions, architecture violations, and missing behavioral verification.

frontmatter.name: raceiq-verifier
frontmatter.description: Selects and runs focused RaceIQ tests and smoke scenarios, returning compact behavioral proof.

frontmatter.name: telemetry-engineer
frontmatter.description: Implements and debugs RaceIQ game telemetry, packet parsing, session import, lap detection, and live pipeline changes.

frontmatter.name: disclose-automated-agent-in-review-replies
frontmatter.description: Prefix every automated GitHub review reply with explicit AI-agent authorship disclosure

frontmatter.name: no-node-modules-research
frontmatter.description: Do not inspect node_modules to research library usage; use official documentation instead
